title: Core Web Vitals for Small Businesses: What Actually Matters

cover.alt: Sculptural mobile page with a reserved image frame, responsive button mechanism and stabilizing feet.

figures.title: Three different kinds of friction
figures.summary: Each metric points to a different part of the visitor's experience.

items.label: Main content
items.detail: LCP concerns when the main visible content appears. Image size and render-blocking resources are useful places to investigate.

items.label: Interaction
items.detail: INP concerns the response to input. Long JavaScript tasks and unnecessary scripts can delay that response.

items.label: Layout stability
items.detail: CLS concerns unexpected movement. Reserved image and embed space helps keep existing content in place.

figures.caption: A conceptual map of the three metrics discussed above, not a measurement of this site.

figures.title: A practical first pass
figures.summary: Start with the assets and scripts, then check the experience and the field report.

items.label: Prepare images
items.detail: Resize and compress images; include their dimensions.

items.label: Review scripts
items.detail: Remove unused third-party code and inspect noncritical loading.

items.label: Try a phone
items.detail: Use the page on a real mobile device and connection.

items.label: Check field data
items.detail: Use Search Console to identify affected URLs and remaining issues.

figures.caption: The article's suggested order for an initial review. A lab test and field data answer different questions.
